sloka: तस्याप्रवेशं ज्ञात्वाऽहमिदं राम महावनम् ।विचरामि सहामात्यो विषादेन विवर्जितः ॥४-११-६५॥।।
transliteration: tasyāpraveśaṁ jñātvā'hamidaṁ rāma mahāvanam ।vicarāmi sahāmātyo viṣādena vivarjitaḥ ॥4-11-65॥।।

translations.english: 'O Rama aware of the prohibition of Vali from entering the place, I roam about this great forest accompanied by my ministers without any apprehension.
